services.name: Driveway replacement
services.blurb: A heaved or flaking driveway replaced with an air-entrained mix made for hard freezes and deicer.

services.name: Slab lifting
services.blurb: Sunken walks and driveway panels raised level again, so melt water stops running toward the house.

services.name: Patios
services.blurb: A patio set on a thick, compacted base, so swelling clay has less room to push it around.

services.name: Walkways and steps
services.blurb: Front walks and steps with a broom texture that still grips on an icy morning.

services.name: Winter damage repair
services.blurb: Flaking, pitted or popped surfaces repaired when the slab is sound, replaced when it is not.

services.name: Stamped and colored concrete
services.blurb: Flagstone and granite-toned patterns that sit right next to red rock and pine.

services.name: Garage floors
services.blurb: Garage slabs repaired and sealed against the slush that drips off the car all winter.

services.name: Sealing and upkeep
services.blurb: Fall sealing on a schedule, so magnesium chloride from the roads stays out of the surface.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our driveway in Monument had peeled like an onion after a few winters of road slush. Jolene explained air in the mix and why they would not trowel it slick. New one has been through two winters clean.
reviews.name: Curtis A.

reviews.text: The walk by the garage sank about two inches and every melt ran right at our foundation. They lifted it in one morning and sloped it back the right way.
reviews.name: Megan F.

reviews.text: We are on that clay that moves. They dug deeper than the other quotes, put down more base, and told us straight that no one can promise clay will never move. Patio is flat after three years.
reviews.name: Ray C.

reviews.text: Steep lot in Manitou, narrow street, no room for the truck. They pumped from the road and protected the neighbor's wall the whole time.
reviews.name: Ingrid L.

reviews.text: They came back in September to seal it like they said they would, without me calling. Small thing, but nobody else ever did.
reviews.name: Doug B.

reviews.text: Pitted garage floor from years of slush. They ground it, filled the pits and sealed it. Water beads off now instead of soaking in. Fair price, done in a day and a half.
reviews.name: Alyssa K.

proof.guarantee: We come back every fall for the first 2 years to look at your slab and reseal it if it needs it.
